data_notes: This cycle covers the photographer sub-segment of the watchlist only (15 creators). Hospitality brands, travel creators, and social media strategists will be added in subsequent runs.
dpc_photography_ has likes hidden on all posts. Baseline and multipliers for this account use shares + saves as the interaction proxy. Multipliers are directional only.
birch has only 9 posts in the dataset with very low raw counts (median = 14 interactions). Multipliers are directional only — thin baseline.
Post URLs were available for 49 of 218 posts via cross-reference with the watchlist collection. Remaining 169 posts have profile-level links only. Top post embeds use only confirmed shortcodes.
SocialBlade returned 403 (bot-blocking) for all attempted fetches. Follower counts and growth context sourced from creator_profile fields in the individual JSON files.
No view counts present in dataset — views field omitted from all posts.

saturated.sub: Short atmospheric captions naming a place with no perspective or hook make up the majority of POV posts — lowest differentiation, highest volume across all 15 creators.
Multiple photographers are running near-identical golden-hour Cotswolds reels simultaneously — the format still performs but the visual language is commoditising fast.

hooks.text: "The suite had one window that faced east. I built the entire shoot around what happened at 7am."
hooks.rationale: Models the precision POV pattern behind @_lagiuditta's and @austinrutland's highest-performing posts — both anchor on one hyper-specific sensory detail rather than a broad location claim. Natural light as a deliberate craft decision is Natalie's core differentiator, and framing it as a professional choice rather than a lucky moment speaks directly to hospitality clients evaluating photographers.

hooks.text: "I've shot 40+ hotel properties. The ones that book fastest all have one thing in common — and it's not the pool."
hooks.rationale: Draws from the authority plus curiosity gap combination that @hayleykelsingphotography and @novemberstudio.co use to drive saves. The specific credential grounds it in Natalie's real portfolio, while the withholding creates a read-through pull. Connects her Forbes Five-Star training context to a commercial outcome that hospitality marketing teams care about directly.

hooks.text: "My hotel quirks: I always check the light before the minibar. Every single time."
hooks.rationale: The only relatability hook in the 218-post dataset hit 4.39x baseline for @adriana_maria_ — the most uncontested lane in the photographer cohort right now. Adapts it to Natalie's specific brand behaviour (light-first thinking) rather than generic hotel humour. Warm, specific, and immediately positions natural light as an instinct rather than a technical setting.

citations.text: Creator JSON files — per-account post exports with likes, comments, shares, saves, audio, captions, and slide visual descriptions. 15 photographer accounts, 218 posts.
SocialBlade — attempted fetch for creator growth context. All requests returned 403 (bot-blocking). Follower data sourced from creator_profile fields in individual JSON files.

Engagement baseline: median interactions (likes + comments) per creator across valid posts in dataset. dpc_photography_ baseline uses shares + saves (likes hidden). Multiplier = post interactions / creator median.
Analysis: Claude (Anthropic). Hook classification, theme clustering, multiplier calculation, open lane identification, hook generation in Natalie's voice.
